subject: website
name: Chainza SAFE Staking
summary: Chainza SAFE Staking, a non-custodial staking UI, open source (MIT) in Chainza/safenet-staking-monorepo. It loads no script or frame from another host, which is Level 3. It is not Level 4: its bundled wallet kit calls api.web3modal.org and pulse.walletconnect.org when it opens, and it needs an RPC endpoint, the Chainza API and a validator list from GitHub.

connections.name: WalletConnect and Reown (api.web3modal.org, pulse.walletconnect.org)
connections.note: Configuration and telemetry requests from the site's own bundled wallet kit when the page opens, before a wallet is connected.

connections.name: RPC and API (eth.blockrazor.xyz, api.chainza.io)
